body.name: oracle GENE recovery map
body.construction: \(\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{or}}(P,\pi)\) repeatedly applies an insertion attaining \(\max_{r\ne s}C_P(\pi;r,s)>0\) until no positive gain remains; from the resulting complete ordered DAG it repeatedly deletes \(u\to v\) exactly when \(H(v,A\setminus\{u\},u)=0\), with \(A\) the current ordered parent set of \(v\).
